drawing: Narrow 1-door bookcase; no dimension lines. Carcass 568 between sides + 2×16 = 600 wide; top 1 and bottom 4 (630×450, 25 mm thick) overhang ~15 each side. Sides 2/3 (2040×426) stand on the bottom 4 (step 1.7: body set on the bottom with Direkta 19); top 1 sits on the sides (Rastex), with cornice 11 (710×80 front) + 12/13 (490×80 sides) screwed on the top with 4x25 screws 22 (step 1.9). Plinth box 8/9 (620×70 front/back) + 10 (372×70 ends, 25 mm) under the bottom, joined by Rastex, fixed with 4 brackets 34, 4 adjustable feet 35. Pilasters 14 (2040×22) on the front edges of both sides. Inside, top to bottom: open upper part with removable shelf 6, removable shelf 6, fixed shelf 15 (568×410, mid-height), removable shelf 6, then fixed partition 5 (568×425) — the horizontal board that closes the lower door compartment (~718 up); below it one more removable shelf 6 behind the door. 16 pins 23 = 4 removable shelves × 4. Door 7 (700×564) inset (вкладная) into the lower compartment, 2 inset hinges 25, 1 handle 33. Upper part open (no door, no glass). Back ДВП scheme (p2): 16 (1368×597) over the upper open part, 17 (718×597) over the door compartment. Note: hardware pos. 30 is absent in the table (numbering jumps 29 → 31).
